messages:
Jordan: Quick sync - T-7 days to the joint catalog launch. Need final signoff on: press embargo window, landing hero copy, demo env + SI runbook. Who's owning last-pass on copy and timeline?
Priya: I can own copy signoff. Draft here: https://docs.google.com/draft/partner-launch-copy - want approvals by EOD Thu. @Maya (Partner) please review legal callouts. :eyes: 
Ken: Demo infra status: staging cluster healthy, but need final seeded data and a partner device in the lab for the hardware demo. ETA to ship device from partner?
Maya (Partner): Hardware team says device ships next Tue if we confirm customs info today. Also legal needs the embargo text updated - can you paste final PR line for our counsel?
Sam: Proposed announcement flow: 10:00 PT - embargoed blog post & customer case to partners; 10:05 PT - internal comms; 13:00 PT - joint press release + live demo webinar (30m). That gives press time to prep assets. Thoughts?
Jordan: Sounds good. Press window locked at 10:00 PT. Action: Priya to publish blog under embargo; Sam to coordinate press list; Ken to have demo ready for 12:30 PT dry-run.
Priya: Landing page path will be /partners/catalog-launch. Hero variants A/B ready. Copy snippet for counsel:
"Today we’re announcing a joint solution with ACME Hardware that simplifies LLM inference at scale. Early access available via the partner catalog. For press embargo details contact press@redwood.com."
Please confirm legal language ok.
Maya (Partner): That copy is fine aside from one line - change "ACME Hardware" to "ACME" per branding. Legal will confirm embargo sign-off once updated copy is in.
Ken: Demo checklist (quick):
- seed dataset v2 loaded
- partner device connected + network NAT tested
- API keys for demo account created
- failover route to hosted model established
I’ll run through this in a 12:30 PT dry-run with @QA-bot.
QA-bot: CI deploy status: staging-infra v3.4 deployed - smoke tests passed (3/3). Logs:
> helm upgrade staging-infra ./charts -f values.staging.yaml
> deploy succeeded: all pods ready
Jordan: Great. Two operational asks left: (1) on-call rota for launch day (pairing with partner SI) and (2) partner promo asset drop (logos, screenshots) - Sam can you confirm roster and asset deadline?
Sam: On-call rota: Jordan, Ken, and Maya (Partner) on primary, Priya on comms standby. Asset deadline: assets.zip by Monday 5pm PT. I'll chase design now. :spiral_calendar:
Priya: Final acceptance criteria for blog/landing:
- legal embargo signed (Maya)
- hero copy approved (me + Sam)
- assets zipped and uploaded to /shared/launch/assets (Sam)
- demo dry-run successful (Ken + QA-bot)
If all met by Monday 5pm PT we go live as scheduled.
Maya (Partner): Confirmed on legal, will update copy now and send final sign-off. Shipping details submitted.
Jordan: Thank you everyone - I’ll compile a one-page Launch Day runbook and post here by EOD today. Flag any blockers in this thread. :rocket:
